topic: Safety of women and children at home
syllabus_extract: Safety of women and children at home
specific_objectives: 33.1.3.1 Trainee will be able to state the need for safety at work, home road and monsoon season.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Discussion on home safety hazards; Safety precautions during monsoon; Instructor supervision of group discussion
intro_questions: What are the primary safety hazards at home?
How does the monsoon season affect home safety?
Why is road safety important for women and children?

topics: First aid kit essentials at home
development.content:
General home safety requirements
Electrical and fire safety measures

topics: Road safety for women and children
development.content:
Road safety for women and children
Traffic rules and pedestrian safety
Use of helmets and seatbelts
Safe crossing techniques at junctions
Awareness of vehicle blind spots

Waterlogging and electrical hazards
Slippery surface precautions

Disease prevention measures at home

summary_questions: List three key safety measures for home electrical systems.
Explain the importance of wearing helmets while riding vehicles.
Describe two precautions to take during monsoon season to ensure home safety.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on safety measures to be taken at home during the upcoming monsoon season, referencing the next lesson plan on school safety.
